In this farm simulator, you'll have the opportunity to build, grow, and customize your very own farm in the charming village, nestled deep within the valley. Help bring life back to the lost mansion of the Foggs, a family of renowned adventurers.

As you plant and harvest your way through the farm, you'll also have the chance to explore the world, and uncover the many secrets of your life. Plant a variety of crops and watch them grow, as you discover the joy of adventure. Meet a cast of mysterious and fascinating characters, including Uncle Stan and his faithful friend Thomas, and brave Sid and Captain Meatball.

Take part in fun and exciting village events and earn decorations for your farm, compete with players from all over the world, and top the rating to earn cool prizes. Customize your character's look with a hairstyle and color of your choice.

Go on adventures with new friends, find undiscovered places, and enjoy incredible quests unique to every expedition. Solve exciting mysteries, restore home hiding more secrets, and collect rare resources.

In this exciting fairy game, you'll have endless opportunities to decorate your farm, meet with game characters, and make new friends. Start the wonder mobile adventures!
